datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data collected by FEWS NET enumerators through regular monthly surveys across Malawi administrative units. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications (representing food insecurity severity) are compiled into spatial datasets with scenario projections for near-term food security outlook.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity and geographic extent.
